title: GitHub issue-comment exact response parity governed migration readiness

phases.objective: Provide one fresh-event, exact-token, Production-bound, checksum-bound readiness bridge for the GitHub issue-comment exact-response parity migration that records governed authorization and performs dry-run only, while preserving exact envelope-create failure provenance and reconciling ambiguous create outcomes with a bounded SELECT-only ledger readback.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Issue 4451 fresh exact migration authorization comment on the trusted default-branch workflow
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow proves source migration identity and exact Production/runtime parity, creates a short-lived capability envelope, records checksum-bound authorization, and completes governed_migration_execute in dry_run mode with applies_sql=false; if envelope creation fails, it performs exact-run SELECT-only reconciliation and stops before approval/bootstrap/Dry Run continuation.
steps: Require issue 4451, the exact authorization token, OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR author association, and GitHub run attempt 1 so a consumed authorization event cannot be manually rerun.
Require source PR 6814 merge identity, migration Git blob SHA, raw-byte SHA-256 checksum, and executable statement count to remain pinned.
Require protected Production and public runtime readbacks to equal 6957f56ead3f720767957dbb7b9b213cc54ed04e before authorization mutation.
Re-read protected Production after runtime parity and fail closed if the ref moved.
Create a per-run requested_by correlation key from GitHub run ID plus run attempt and mark the managed control-plane create outcome attempted_unknown before the request.

If envelope creation fails, preserve sanitized HTTP/payload/stdout/stderr provenance, perform a SELECT-only ledger readback filtered by the exact requested_by key, classify no_matching_row_after_failure, matching_row_persisted_response_failed, or reconciliation_unavailable, and stop.

Only after a successful create response mark the control-plane write confirmed; create or approve the short-lived capability resolution envelope scoped to governed_migration_authorization_bootstrap and the exact migration resource binding.
Call governed_migration_authorization_bootstrap using the exact filename, checksum, statement count, source PR, source merge SHA, typed confirmation, and envelope ID.
Invoke governed_migration_execute only in dry_run mode and require applies_sql=false with exact checksum and statement count.
Upload sanitized evidence recording Migration Apply, provider call, external write, credential payload access, protected-ref mutation, and force push as false.
assertions: The workflow exposes no Apply trigger, phase, or job.
A manual rerun of the same authorization event fails before any envelope write; a new cycle requires a fresh exact issue comment.
Envelope-create outcome is represented as not_attempted, attempted_unknown, or confirmed and a failed response is never reported as a confirmed non-write.
Envelope-create failure reconciliation is SELECT-only and correlated to the exact GitHub run ID plus run attempt through requested_by.
A failed envelope-create response cannot proceed to envelope approval, authorization bootstrap, or governed_migration_execute.
The wrapper contains no governed_migration_execute call with mode apply and no Apply confirmation token.
Production drift, runtime drift, source identity drift, migration checksum drift, statement-count drift, authorization failure, or dry-run contract failure fails closed.
The bridge never dispatches github_create_issue_comment and performs no provider call or protected-ref mutation.
